page.overview:
Who is Kebi?

Kebi was a member of the Sand-Sand Clan and, later, of the Arabasta Rebel Army.

Kebi is a tan-skinned man with black hair put into a ponytail with a grey tie. He wears a navy blue sleeveless shirt and a dark red hat. He also has brown goggles that he keeps on his hat.

Kebi was willing to risk his life for a cause he believed in. As a member of the Rebel Army, he was willing to fight against the Arabasta royal guards and only wanted what was best for the country.

He also cares deeply for others, rushing to both Koza and Kappa when they were hurt. He expressed concern for Koza throughout the conflict, supporting him as a close friend.
